input.question: When playing roulette at a casino, what's the strategy of those folks who are putting chips on a large portion of the individual numbers?
input.ground_truth: There really is no strategy to roulette, it's all just guessing. Every dollar you bet has an expected return of 93 cents, slightly more if there's only one zero. It's the most transparent gambling game there is.

These kids are hoping that when the wheel stops, the little ball will land on one of the numbers they picked. By putting chips on lots of numbers, they have a better chance that the ball will land on one of their numbers. But, if the ball lands on a number they didn’t pick, they don’t win as much as if they had put all their chips on just one number.

So, their strategy is to try to win more often, but not win a lot of money each time. It’s like casting a big net to catch more fish, but each fish isn’t very big.
